description: Repurposed Lenovo Legion R7000P 2020H Windows laptop with an AMD Ryzen 7 4800H CPU, 32 GB memory, and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 graphics. It remains in active use for local software development, Codex-assisted work, GitHub bounty automation, and RustChain miner dry-run validation instead of being replaced. The 65 W value is a transparent approximate mixed development-load estimate rather than a wall-meter measurement.
